name: architect
short: A second, independent LLM agent reachable only over A2A
description: Architect is an A2A-only LLM agent registered on corridor's shared listener. It performs structural editor-layout mutations through pixelagents' validated revisioned state facade. CCTV owns the browser view; Architect has no Dashboard or WebSocket surface.
end_user_data_statement: This cog sends A2A task messages it receives to corridor's configured LLM endpoint. It does not persistently store any data or metadata about Discord users.
install_msg: Requires corridor and pixelagents (both auto-loaded). Configure the shared LLM with [p]corridor llm endpoint/key/model and the shared A2A listener with [p]corridor a2a host/port. Load cctv separately if a browser view of the editor aggregate is wanted.
author: Pixel Agents HQ Contributors
